Name: Biological Sciences Electives Specifications
Constraints: At least 18 units must be at the 03-3xx level or above (excluding 03-445 and 03-545 and interdisciplinary electives). Up to three interdisciplinary electives may count as general biology electives. Up to 18 units of 03-445 Undergraduate Research and/or 03-545 Honors Research may count as general biology electives; a maximum of 36 units of research can count toward the minimum units required for graduation. Courses in biology taken through cross-registration or study abroad may count as electives with prior permission.
